start_sequence: inspect actual repository tree and current source before trusting status text
preserve unknown bytes with INCBIN or equivalent byte-preserving baseline
verify reconstructed ranges byte-exactly before promoting them to matched
inspect actual repository tree and current project status
identify exact target/revision and metadata-only hashes
map symbols and subsystems from observed evidence
reconstruct source incrementally and verify reproduced or matched output

progress_policy: Never reset or overwrite a repository that already contains more advanced work.
When status documentation conflicts with source/manifests, inspect the actual tree and synchronize the status to the observed repository state.
Do not invent addresses, symbols, formats, revisions, hashes, or semantic names.
Retail ROM/game images and key material are never committed; reconstructed source, analysis, manifests, tooling, tests, patches, and permitted assets are committed.
